blocking_issue.name: all_horizon_shift_terminal_semantics_mismatch
blocking_issue.affected_branch: V40 interval completion after nested V39 hard set is empty
blocking_issue.uploaded_behavior: shift schedule copies original edges 1..H-1 and always appends 0 (nominal)
blocking_issue.frozen_V39_behavior: LOWER_ALL/UPPER_ALL append -1/+1 respectively to preserve the all-horizon endpoint policy
blocking_issue.why_material: The full one-step shift certificate is a hard admission condition. Changing its terminal control can reject otherwise valid interior first-action witnesses. V40 found only 19 shift-closed interval witnesses among 1,551,139 interval hypotheses, so even a sparse false-negative channel is potentially material to the failed recall gate.
blocking_issue.consequence: Do not attribute V40 failure to the first-action interval hypothesis and do not select a V41 research branch from these outcomes. Fix schedule semantics, add a regression test, and rerun equivalence16 + counterfactual48 under the unchanged six-item gate.

provisional_mechanism_counts.aggregation: probe/certificate/action-change weighted pooled reconstruction from scenario diagnostics
provisional_mechanism_counts.interpretation: The inherited six-item outcome gate is unchanged. Interval-only/new-first-action support and actual new-first-action selection are required to attribute any gain specifically to V40 first-action interval completion, but are not post-hoc additional promotion thresholds.
